operating_notes.text: Income-tax assessment for FY2022-23 added ₹31.37 Cr to returned income, producing a demand including interest of ₹13.74 Cr; a penalty show cause notice followed and the company will appeal.
Rights issue proceeds of ₹249.89 Cr fully utilized or deployed in fixed deposits and monitoring accounts with zero deviation.
FY26 customer mix: Maruti Suzuki 60% (56% FY25), Toyota 10% (12%), Honda 5% (8%), Mahindra & Mahindra and Tata together 10%, exports 3% (2%).
New line utilisation in FY26: CVJ Line 2 27%, CVJ Line 1 83%, MS Gear Line 5 Dharuhera 106%, MS Gear Line 6 21%, CPS Line 3 Bawal 50%.
CVJ capacity is 7.54 lakh units across two lines, about ₹250 Cr of sales value; the product is almost 100% localised.
Existing CVJ capacity is about 1.2 million units, currently at about 90% utilisation, per the filing.

A 0.8 million unit CVJ capacity addition at Jalisana, Gujarat is planned by August 2028, funded by a mix of internal accruals and borrowings, with the investment amount yet to be approved by the Board.

timeline.summary: 7 May 2026: Jtekt India disclosed a FY2022-23 income-tax assessment order with additions of ₹31.37 Cr and a demand including interest of ₹13.74 Cr, plus a penalty show cause notice; it will appeal.
May 14, 2026: Jtekt India submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 showing full deployment of ₹249.89 Cr rights issue proceeds.
Jtekt India Limited uploaded the audio recording of its 20th May 2026 Analysts & Investors Meet on audited FY/Q4 2025-26 results via its website.

25 May 2026: Jtekt India filed the transcript of its 20 May 2026 Q4FY26 earnings call, where management said new lines should be fully utilised within 1.5 years and guided to ₹800 Cr of extra sales over two years.
22 October 2026: Jtekt India approved a 0.8 million unit capacity expansion for its CVJ line in Jalisana, Gujarat, to be completed by August 2028.
